parameters.jsCode: const body=$input.first().json.body||{};const sheetRows=$('Load Competitor Config').all().map(r=>r.json).filter(r=>r.competitor_name&&r.active!=='false');let competitors;if(body.competitors&&Array.isArray(body.competitors)&&body.competitors.length>0){competitors=body.competitors.slice(0,6).map(c=>({name:c.name||c,domain:c.domain||'',focusAreas:Array.isArray(c.focus_areas)?c.focus_areas:(c.focus_areas||'pricing,product,news').split(',').map(f=>f.trim())}));}else{competitors=sheetRows.slice(0,6).map(r=>({name:r.competitor_name.trim(),domain:r.domain||'',focusAreas:(r.focus_areas||'pricing,product,news').split(',').map(f=>f.trim())}));}if(competitors.length===0)return[{json:{error:'No competitors configured'}}];const yourCompany=body.your_company||sheetRows[0]?.your_company||'';const recipientEmails=body.recipient_emails||(sheetRows[0]?.recipient_emails||'').split(',').map(e=>e.trim()).filter(Boolean);return[{json:{competitors,yourCompany,recipientEmails,triggeredManually:!!body.competitors}}];

values.content: You analyze competitor intelligence for a SaaS company. From search results, extract what's actually new and competitively relevant — product updates, pricing changes, funding, partnerships, executive moves, marketing shifts. Ignore PR puff. Be specific. Always respond in valid JSON only.
